topic: What if you acted like GTA 6 in real life for 24 hours?

script.text: Eight a.m. You wake up and make a decision. For the next twenty-four hours, you're going to live exactly like a character in GTA 6.
You don't walk to the bus stop. You sprint. Full speed, arms pumping, just like the game.
At the crosswalk, the light is red. You don't wait. In the game, nobody waits. A bus honks so loudly your teeth buzz, and you jump back onto the curb.
You jump the neighbor's fence instead of using the gate. Your hoodie stays on the fence. You don't.
A car is parked outside the bakery. In the game, that's your car now. You grab the handle.
It's locked. The alarm goes off. And the owner, a little old lady holding a baguette, is standing right behind you.
In the game, this is where the fun starts. In real life, this is where the paperwork starts.
So what would actually happen if you acted like GTA 6, in real life, for twenty-four hours?
